stories.title: Democrat Chuck Hubbard wins recount in North Carolina US House race, unseats Republican Rep. Virginia Foxx
stories.summary: Democratic Chuck Hubbard will win the election in North Carolina's 5th congressional district, the Associated Press projects.

stories.title: More rain expected to impact Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: Rain is expected Wednesday night into Thursday across Central NC.

stories.title: US Army plans to invoke emergency provisions to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa
stories.summary: The Army said it plans to invoke emergency provisions to detonate bomb-making chemicals Wednesday in Iowa "to allow for optimal weather conditions" and for all mitigation measures to be put in place.

stories.title: Automation system problem at Delta causes flight delays as Americans travel for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: An issue with Delta Air Lines’ weight and balance automation system was causing flight delays Sunday at its hub in Atlanta and nationwide.

stories.title: Sunday's rain is beginning to let up along Glenwood Avenue in Raleigh
Teen killed in shooting at Roanoke Rapids apartment complex, police investigating
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a teen was shot and killed overnight at a Roanoke Rapids apartment complex.

stories.title: Cary duo wins grand prize at National Gingerbread House Competition
stories.summary: Two Cary artists won the grand prize at the 2026 National Gingerbread House Competition in Asheville.

stories.title: Rising costs drive more families to seek food assistance, NC food bank says
stories.summary: The Food Bank of Central & Eastern NC says more than 600,000 people need help as rising costs drive more families to seek food assistance.

stories.title: Appeals court says federal law requiring accommodations for pregnant workers is unconstitutional
stories.summary: An appeals court has struck down a federal law that requires workplaces to provide accommodations for pregnant women.

stories.title: Hope Mills man wins $200K lottery prize, plans Disney World trip with daughter
stories.summary: A Hope Mills dad plans to take his daughter to Disney World after winning a $200,000 lottery prize.

stories.title: UN climate conference ends without its signature agreement as countries clash over fossil fuels and finance
stories.summary: Participating nations in the U.N. COP31 climate conference failed to reach consensus on fossil fuels, finance and other issues.

stories.summary: The director of national intelligence appeared on ABC's "This Week" Sunday.
